what: Leave-scenes-out cross-validation (5 folds) of one-step rankers over the ladder's survivors, trained on the stack-arm rollout labels (arm stack:reports/wedge/ppo-stack-c1-s0-tower, k=5, explore_eps 0.2). Regret = best sampled survivor's continuation minus the pick's, averaged over held-out decisions where the survivors differ; the ladder's own pick is the baseline. Candidate-feature MLP (bench/ranker.py, context keys zeroed) on the label 'fill_gain'; board value net (bench/valuenet.py, 20 epochs, every third continuation board) on the boards' return-to-go in items, one 20 % scene split.

rollouts-stack-train.note: 16 of 96 train scenes did not finish in the runners' 330 min; c1 285, c1s 378, c2 238, c2p 455 decisions

board_value_net.labels: train boards (48 single-container scenes, 36522 boards, 13124 used)

reading: Neither one-step evaluator beats the ladder's own pick on held-out scenes at this label scale; overrides are right about one time in three. The wins are mostly a different pose of the same kind (shelf against shelf, terrace against terrace), and the only systematic signal is weak (flatter, larger-footprint poses do slightly better). The search's +4.4 points come from evaluating the actual continuation, not from anything a candidate or its board shows in one step.
